content: {"summary":"On 18 Mar 2025 payments‑api‑03 emitted ~40 PAYAPI‑W0310 logs per second because fraud‑scorer‑01 was throttling its CPU. The throttling stemmed from the pod running 16 gunicorn workers (WEB_CONCURRENCY unset) against a CPU limit far below 16 cores, causing CFS throttling, delayed fraud scores and the PAYAPI‑W0310 spikes. Raising the CPU limit stopped throttling and the error logs.","likely_cause":"WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset, causing too many gunicorn workers to exceed the pod's CPU limit and trigger throttling on fraud‑scorer‑01","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"PAYAPI‑W0310 appeared at about 40 a second on payments‑api‑03 on 18 Mar 2025","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#0","RB-002#3"],"quote":"about 40 a second, each one a payment where the fraud score arrived too late"},{"text":"fraud‑scorer‑01 showed ~45 % average CPU but ~30 % throttled periods, indicating CFS throttling","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#0","INC-0024#1","RB-002#3"],"quote":"fraud-scorer-01 was at 30% of periods throttled"},{"text":"WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset, so the pod started a worker for each of the 16 node cores, exceeding its CPU limit","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#2"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset in the Deployment, so the entrypoint had counted the cores it could see"},{"text":"Raising the CPU limit reduced throttling and stopped the PAYAPI‑W0310 logs","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#2","INC-0024#3"],"quote":"the `PAYAPI-W0310` lines from payments-api-03 had stopped"}],"next_checks":["Verify that WEB_CONCURRENCY is set appropriately in the fraud‑scorer deployment","Add an alert for high CFS throttling percentages on critical pods","Monitor worker count vs. CPU limit after any deployment change","Review if the increased CPU limit is sustainable long‑term"]}
